name: Mifuyutsuku-bi
source:
A mining visual novel that delves deep into a snow-covered mine.

The start of a long and brutally cold winter heralds a changing of monarchs.

The Winter Kingdom Isenvindar holds a succession ceremony in those years marked by unusually harsh winters.

Three siblings stand as potential successors this time: the eldest, a cheerful wanderer; the second, a stern swordsman; and the youngest, a wise and kind soul.

Who shall bring an end to this winter and claim the throne?

[From Steam]
